label: Brain
functionSummary: Mood, sleep and cognition. Isolation, confinement and poor sleep strain it during long missions.

label: Eyes
functionSummary: Vision. Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS) can change the eye and optic nerve in microgravity.

label: Heart
functionSummary: Heart rate and blood pressure. Microgravity changes cardiovascular regulation and exercise capacity.

label: Bone
functionSummary: Skeleton and muscle. Low gravity loads bone less, which can reduce bone density over a long mission.

label: Metabolism
functionSummary: Glucose handling and nutrition. Prolonged rest and altered diet change insulin sensitivity.

label: Immune
functionSummary: Immune response. Closed environments, isolation and radiation can alter it; temperature is the early signal.
